title: Certify the bit-motif transfer inequality at the manuscript exponent
body:
## Summary
- At `tau = 1/2` the bit-motif width-1 child list has Psi greater than 1. At the manuscript exponent `tau = 1-2^{-50}` the same list has Psi below 1.
- `s_b/W_b = m(1-eta)` with `m = 1000000` and `eta = 339/22587335000000`. The comparison `2^{50} eta` exceeds six times the ninth harmonic number, and that harmonic number exceeds `ln(10)`.
- No network replay and no new exponent. The complex motif is not evaluated.
